text: The Nov. 8 and Nov. 9 editions named all 12 men listed on Daphne police's arrest log for the Nov. 6 solicitation operation. FOX10 later reported, citing police, that two of them were also detained for immigration authorities. This site does not name immigration detainees; their names have been removed from the Daphne arrests table from the Nov. 10 edition onward.

The Nov. 7 edition said Daphne police arrested eight people on Nov. 6, five on solicitation charges and three — Carlos Maurice Byther, Carlton De'aundre Eonte Lee and Juan Vellejo — on prostitution charges. The department's arrest log, as updated, lists all three on solicitation charges and shows 12 solicitation arrests that day.

The Fairhope police log now lists the Nov. 4 failure-to-appear arrest of Zachary Joseph Wolfe as arising from a second-degree marijuana possession charge, not a fourth-degree theft charge as the Nov. 5 edition reported.

The Fairhope Police arrest log now lists the Nov. 3 arrest of Auburn Jeane Jeffries as assault third degree; the Nov. 4 edition, following the log as first posted, listed criminal mischief third degree. The city arrests table has been updated.

The Nov. 2 edition reported that Andrew James Crenshaw Jr. was booked on a charge of failure to appear on a felony, as the jail roster showed when it was read. The roster now lists his booked charge as burglary of a residence with force.

The Oct. 26 edition counted 132 non-immigration jail bookings for Oct. 19–25. A full re-read of the roster found one booking missed in transcription; the correct count is 133, 94 of them by the sheriff's office.
